verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line saying you can "roll back to any checkpoint in seconds." It refers to Sprites, which are checkpointed agent VMs that can serve live apps over HTTPS, not to release rollback for standard Fly Apps or Machines deployments. That makes it a thin, indirect match for rolling back a deployed service. Missing for 10: documented release/version history and rollback for Fly App deployments, a one-click (UI or single-command) rollback flow, detailed docs on checkpoint rollback semantics, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
